Jimmy looks ill. Jimmy is in bed. He feels ill. He doesn't feel ill. Does he feel ill? How does he feel? He looks ill.
feel funny/ feel like (doing) sth./feel free to do sth.
lose oneself at the first sight I lost myself at the first sight of my wife.
see a doctor/ see the dentist send for a doctor/ ask the doctor Jimmy feels ill today. He looks ill. You must see/call a doctor.
Mrs. Williams must call a doctor.

at the butcher's/at the doctor's middle school Jimmy is a middle school student. He is in bed now. He feels ill. He looks ill. Mrs. Williams is his mother. They must call the doctor. Now Jimmy is at the doctor's.

post When you go by the post office, remember to post the letter.
